_doc: Provider × action × chain support + verified RPC endpoints. preflight.sh pings every endpoints[].url. Updated post-ralphathon-1 with confirmed CoinFello + direct_viem matrix.

create_account.notes: Secure Enclave-backed by default; --use-unsafe-private-key is FORBIDDEN (guard.ts blocks).

supported_chains: ethereum-mainnet (SIWE_CHAIN_ID=1 for proof only — does NOT execute mainnet)
sign_in.notes: SIWE_CHAIN_ID hardcoded to 1 in CLI. RPC defaults to eth.merkle.io (Cloudflare 429 rate-limit). Override with RPC_URL_OVERRIDE.

send_prompt.evidence: retro/ralphathon-1 F1: live test returned 'I can't prepare that swap on Base Sepolia with the available swap flow here — Base Sepolia isn't supported by this route.'

approve_delegation_request.prerequisite: send_prompt must have created pending_delegation.json first
approve_delegation_request.evidence: retro/ralphathon-1 K2: calling without prior send_prompt → 'No pending delegation request found'

direct_viem.default_demo_rationale: retro/ralphathon-1 today: Sepolia PoW faucet (pk910) works without prior mainnet funding; Base Sepolia faucets (Alchemy/Coinbase) require existing mainnet balance or CDP account. Sepolia is the default unless operator has a funded Base Sepolia signer.

attestation_tx.purpose: Anchor (approver, delegationIntentHash) onchain via 0-value self-tx. NOT a swap.
attestation_tx.signer_env: FELLOPILOT_TESTNET_SIGNER_KEY (testnet-only — generated via scripts/harness/generate_testnet_signer.sh; persisted at ~/.fellopilot/signer.env for cross-project reuse)
attestation_tx.gas_required: ≈21000 gas per tx; signer needs testnet ETH on the chosen chain

sepolia: https://sepolia-faucet.pk910.de/ (browser PoW — no mainnet required, VERIFIED WORKING)

executeMock.contract: txHash === undefined && explorerUrl === undefined && simulated === true

ethereum-mainnet.purpose: CoinFello SIWE eth_getCode (RPC_URL_OVERRIDE candidate; replaces eth.merkle.io)

compatibility_matrix.M1_acceptance: Pick coinfello if action.swap.supported_chains intersects active chain; otherwise pick direct_viem; never silently fall through to mock without SIMULATION label.
